title: X7: Recurrence spawn has no idempotency key

description: nextOccurrenceAfter is the only guard, and the trump merge policy lets a concurrent widget/app interaction, or two devices closing the same task near-simultaneously, double-spawn the identical occurrence under distinct IDs - the reconciler has no way to collapse them. RecurrenceLog is an os.Logger call, not a ledger. Severity: High. Wave/Plan: Wave 4, plan 4c recurrence-correctness. Sweep: cross-process. Fix approach: deterministic occurrence identity (e.g. UUIDv5(seriesID, occurrence date)) so double-spawns collapse.
